headline: HOU @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.90 at KCR 4.36, with a projected total of 8.26. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward KCR: HOU moved -0.86 runs while KCR moved +0.01, changing the projected margin by -0.87 runs. The projected total fell -0.86, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Noah Cameron has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Vinnie Pasquantino, Jac Caglianone, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler Tolbert, Joey Loperfido because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
